msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia joyeria-coca-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of yellow gold Virgin medals with mother-of-pearl centres and filigree frames from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia joyeria-coca-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold oval religious medal with a mother-of-pearl centre and an ornate filigree frame from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia joyeria-coca-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of beaded gemstone necklaces in ruby red, sapphire blue and emerald green with small gold pendants from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia joyeria-coca-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold necklace of small round coin links with a matching bangle from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
